Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to log in with valid credentials.
Acceptance Criteria: A user with valid credentials is authenticated and redirected to the inventory page.

Requirement Description: The application shall reject an invalid username.
Acceptance Criteria: Login is unsuccessful and an authentication error is displayed; the user remains on the login page.

Requirement Description: The application shall reject an invalid password.
Acceptance Criteria: Login is unsuccessful and an authentication error is displayed; the user remains on the login page.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate that the username is provided.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting the login form with an empty username displays a required-username validation message.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate that the password is provided.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting the login form with an empty password displays a required-password validation message.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate login submissions with both credential fields empty.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting with both fields empty is rejected and the username-required message is displayed.

Requirement Description: The application shall prevent a locked-out account from logging in.
Acceptance Criteria: Login is unsuccessful and a locked-out-account message is displayed.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow an authenticated user to log out.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting Logout ends the session and returns the user to the login page.

Requirement Description: The application shall display the available products on the inventory page.
Acceptance Criteria: The inventory page displays product entries with their available information.

Requirement Description: The application shall display product names and prices.
Acceptance Criteria: Each displayed product has the correct name and price.

Requirement Description: The application shall support sorting products by name in ascending order.
Acceptance Criteria: Products are displayed alphabetically from A to Z after selecting the corresponding sort option.

Requirement Description: The application shall support sorting products by name in descending order.
Acceptance Criteria: Products are displayed alphabetically from Z to A after selecting the corresponding sort option.

Requirement Description: The application shall support sorting products by price in ascending order.
Acceptance Criteria: Products are displayed from the lowest price to the highest price after selecting the corresponding sort option.

Requirement Description: The application shall support sorting products by price in descending order.
Acceptance Criteria: Products are displayed from the highest price to the lowest price after selecting the corresponding sort option.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to open a product's detail view.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting a product opens its detail view and displays the product information.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to add a product to the shopping cart.
Acceptance Criteria: The selected product appears in the cart and the cart indicator reflects the addition.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to add multiple products to the shopping cart.
Acceptance Criteria: All selected products appear in the cart and the cart indicator reflects the number of items.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to remove a product from the inventory page after adding it.
Acceptance Criteria: The product is removed from the cart and the cart indicator is updated.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to remove a product from the cart page.
Acceptance Criteria: The selected product is removed from the cart and the displayed cart contents are updated.

Requirement Description: The application shall display the details of products added to the cart.
Acceptance Criteria: The cart displays the selected product information, including its name and price.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to return from the cart to continue shopping.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting Continue Shopping returns the user to the inventory page.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to begin checkout from the shopping cart.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting Checkout opens the checkout information form.

Requirement Description: The application shall accept valid customer information during checkout.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting valid first name, last name and postal code allows the user to proceed to the order overview.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate that the first name is provided.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting checkout information with an empty first name is rejected with a relevant validation message.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate that the last name is provided.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting checkout information with an empty last name is rejected with a relevant validation message.

Requirement Description: The application shall validate that the postal code is provided.
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting checkout information with an empty postal code is rejected with a relevant validation message.

Requirement Description: The application shall display an order overview before order completion.
Acceptance Criteria: The overview displays the selected items and applicable order totals.

Requirement Description: The application shall calculate and display the item total and tax.
Acceptance Criteria: The displayed item total equals the sum of item prices and the displayed tax follows the application's calculation.

Requirement Description: The application shall allow a user to complete an order.
Acceptance Criteria: Completing checkout displays an order confirmation or completion message.
